name: Reciprocal Jersey Guernsey
description: A reciprocal social security agreement between New Zealand and Jersey/Guernsey governing the portability and entitlement of New Zealand benefits and pensions for clients residing in or moving to Jersey/Guernsey, and the recognition of Jersey/Guernsey pensions or benefits in New Zealand.

attributes.summary: Policy governing the reciprocal social security agreement with Jersey/Guernsey, including entitlements for Jobseeker Support, Sole Parent Support, Supported Living Payment, NZ Superannuation, and Veterans Pension for clients in Jersey/Guernsey and vice versa.
